summary: First Breach filed a 424B5 resale prospectus covering up to 50,887,472 shares, comprising 887,472 advisor shares issued to Dawson James for direct-listing services and 50,000,000 shares issuable under a May 21, 2026 equity line of credit with RK Capital Management, North Commerce Parkway Capital and TQP Holdings. The ELOC permits up to $50 million of at-will sales at 97% of market price, or 99% intraday. Proceeds accrue to the company; selling holders may resell immediately. Watch dilution and ELOC pricing overhang rather than a deal event.
